Class_Skill_Desc_Iainuki: Delivers an attack with a potency of 500 to all enemies in a cone before you.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Additional Effect: 10% chance to kill target instantly, with some exceptions
Class_Skill_Desc_Shirahadori: Renders you impervious to most physical damage for one attack.</br>Duration: 4s
Class_Skill_Desc_Zeninage: Consume an Occult Coffer to deliver a guaranteed strike with a potency of 1,500.</br>Potency scales with item level.</br>Can only be executed while you possess an Occult Coffer.
Class_Trait_Desc_Enhanced Iainuki: Increases the potency of Iainuki to 500, and increases chance to instantly kill target to 10%.
